'''Observance Day''' was a [[holiday]] celebrated by the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] continent [[Alanciar]]. Held once every ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Observance Day featured plays, often celebrating the famous "Rock of Kesh", [[Adari Vaal]]. Its main function was to remind the [[Alanciari]] of the "[[Great Cause]]," their duty to resist any invasion by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], a group of offworld [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who resided on the neighboring continent of [[Keshtah Minor]]. Following the Sith [[Invasion of Alanciar|conquest]] of Alanciar in [[2975 BBY]], Observance Day was phased out in favor of festivals which dramatized [[Jogan Halder]]'s [[Testament of Jogan Halder|first contact]] with the Sith, who were portrayed as being benign and peaceful.
